### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Key a streamed artifact by its id so the latest reply does not show twice](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2827) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a session's page, the agent's latest reply, or a tool call it just made, no longer shows twice for a few seconds at the end of a turn.
- (agent-platform) [Let a streamed item advance its polled copy instead of being dropped](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2847) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a session's page, a tool's result shows as soon as the agent receives it, and the agent's reply is never shown cut off part-way.
- (plans-backend) [Cache /content per person, ref and path for 60 s](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2849) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Hive's History tab and plan pages open faster when reopened: the backend keeps each plan file it read from GitHub for 60 seconds, per person. A file changed on GitHub shows within a minute.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2844) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared CircleCI and pre-commit workflows.
- (deps) [Update actions/setup-node action to v7.1.0](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2813) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency @lezer/common to v1.5.3](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2846) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
